principle: Universal soil/irrigation science packs; region/climate are tags only. Samples are illustrative literature notes — never auto-update FlahaSOIL algorithms.
handoffRule: Approved packs INFORM FlahaSOIL / CALC / FAST work. Product algorithm changes require a separate product process.

packs.title: Soil analysis thresholds baseline (sample)
packs.summary: Illustrative EC, pH, and organic-matter notes for greenhouse and open-field vegetable systems. Universal science with place tags — not product defaults.

items.title: Irrigation water / substrate EC upper note (tomato soilless)
items.bodyText: Illustrative literature-style note: many greenhouse tomato guides treat substrate EC above ~2.5–3.5 dS/m as elevated stress risk depending on stage and cultivar. Not a FlahaSOIL default.

items.title: Soil pH suitability band (most vegetables)
items.bodyText: Common agronomy guidance places many vegetables near pH 6.0–7.0 for nutrient availability. Local soils (e.g. calcareous arid zones) often need different management — use region tags, not a hard product wall.

items.title: Organic matter qualitative note
items.bodyText: Higher soil organic matter generally improves water holding and structure. Target bands depend on soil texture and climate; arid open-field systems often start low and benefit from compost programs.

items.title: Lab method pointer — saturated paste EC
items.bodyText: Saturated paste extract EC is a common lab method for soil salinity comparison. Always record method with the number so FlahaSOIL comparisons are apples-to-apples.

items.title: FlahaSOIL comparison workflow (manual)
items.bodyText: Compare literature threshold notes against FlahaSOIL outputs manually. Record deviation notes in PA review; do not silently patch product formulas from this pack.

packs.title: Irrigation and water-saving context (sample)
packs.summary: Universal irrigation practice notes for PA advice paths (FlahaCALC / FlahaFAST later). Place tags only where climate/rules differ.

items.title: Drip irrigation uniformity check
items.bodyText: Periodic catch-can or flow checks help keep emission uniformity high. Poor uniformity wastes water and confuses soil moisture advice.

items.title: Irrigation water EC caution (illustrative)
items.bodyText: Irrigation water EC above ~1.5–2.0 dS/m often needs salinity-aware scheduling and leaching fraction design for sensitive vegetables. Adjust by crop and drainage.

items.title: Equation note placeholder for FlahaCALC/FAST
items.bodyText: Crop water requirement estimates (ETc = Kc × ETo) are the shared backbone for irrigation advice. Pack stores method identity only; CALC/FAST own implementation.

packs.title: Soil moisture × tomato context (sample)
packs.summary: Cross-cutting soil moisture notes for tomato under arid and greenhouse tags — supports scientific writing and product comparison later.

items.title: Avoid chronic water stress at fruit set
items.bodyText: Tomato fruit set and blossom-end rot risk rise under uneven moisture. Prefer consistent irrigation rather than extreme wet/dry cycles in greenhouse systems.

items.title: Reference — measure method with advice
items.bodyText: When citing moisture thresholds, always pair sensor/method (tensiometer, capacitance, gravimetric) with the number.
